headline: Diesel cracks hit record highs as global fuel squeeze deepens
intro: Diesel just pulled off its best flex of the year — record crack spreads and the highest ULSD settlement in over four years — while Trump's refiners summit produced a whole lot of nothing.
overview: Distillate markets are the story: ULSD futures posted their third-highest close ever and diesel cracks are near/at record levels ($91.91/bbl per EIA) as Middle East supply threats and Russian disruptions collide with already-thin global inventories. On the policy side, EPA's 29 Small Refinery Exemptions are drawing fire from soybean groups worried about RIN reallocation and biofuel demand destruction, while Trump's meeting with refiners over pump prices ended without a breakthrough. Operationally, Valero's Port Arthur refinery took a power outage from Storm Edouard, and Sasol flagged continued disruption at its Natref refinery in South Africa, adding to global product-supply anxiety.

stories.title: Global Distillate Tightness Intensifies As Supply Threats Multiply
stories.summary: ULSD futures hit their highest settlement in nearly 4.5 years and third-highest close ever, as Middle East supply threats intensify global distillate tightness.

stories.title: Diesel Cracks Hit Record Highs as Global Fuel Squeeze Deepens
stories.summary: Global diesel refining margins hit record highs as Middle East and Russia disruptions squeeze already-tight fuel markets.

stories.title: Diesel crack spread surges to record $106 a barrel
stories.summary: Diesel crack spread surged to a record $106/bbl amid severe global supply constraints tied to Iran conflict fallout.

stories.title: USA Diesel Hits Highest Since April
stories.summary: U.S. diesel prices climbed to their highest level since the April peak during the U.S.-Iran war's initial phase.

stories.title: Trump leans on refiners to pump more fuel as prices bite ahead of midterms
stories.summary: Trump met refinery chiefs pushing for increased gasoline and diesel output via permitting and regulatory tweaks ahead of midterms, without a clear breakthrough.

stories.title: Trump Picks The Wrong Target To Lower Gas Prices With U.S. Refining
stories.summary: Analysis argues Trump's refiner-pressure approach misreads the real constraints on lowering gas prices via domestic refining.

stories.title: ISG Statement on Small Refinery Exemptions and RIN Reallocation
stories.summary: Illinois Soybean Growers pushed back on EPA's Small Refinery Exemption approvals and RIN reallocation, citing biofuel demand impacts.

stories.title: Small refinery exemptions offer a mixed bag for U.S. farmers
stories.summary: EPA granted 29 Small Refinery Exemptions under the RFS this week, drawing mixed reaction from farm groups over biofuel demand effects.

stories.title: EPA Grants Small Refinery Exemptions Impacting Biofuel Demand and Arkansas Soybeans
stories.summary: EPA's 29 Small Refinery Exemptions could reduce biofuel demand tied to soybean-based feedstocks, per Arkansas ag groups.

stories.title: MSA appreciates Trump administration’s continued focus on US agriculture, domestic biofuels
stories.summary: Missouri Soybean Association backed the administration's move to offset new SRE waivers with reallocation to protect RFS volumes and soy demand.

stories.title: Power outage hits Valero Port Arthur (U.S.) refinery after storm Edouard
stories.summary: Storm Edouard knocked out power at Valero's Port Arthur refinery, shutting one crude unit and cutting the larger CDU to minimum rates.

stories.title: What Is the Oil, Gas Impact of Storm Edouard?
stories.summary: Rigzone examines the broader oil and gas operational impact of Tropical Storm Edouard in the Gulf.

stories.title: Sasol Confirms Continued Disruption at Key South African Refinery
stories.summary: Sasol confirmed continued disruption at its Natref refinery in South Africa, with measures in place to keep the affected unit running through September.

stories.title: ‘Fuel outage’ warning for South Africa
stories.summary: Sasol's CEO warned of a potential jet fuel outage in South Africa, urging airlines to raise fuel stock levels as a precaution.
